title: Finalize Phase 1 Portfolio media management + precise flip-card video/photo interactions

requirements.text: Fix flip-card click handling so Portfolio flip interactions are implemented precisely and do not double-toggle due to overlapping click handlers between FlipCard and PortfolioGrid.

quotes: admin uploads and manages media and descriptions, public flip‑cards for photos and videos with your exact interaction rules, and the hover/click logic for videos vs photos implemented precisely.

acceptanceCriteria: On the public Portfolio page, clicking a photo flips the card exactly once per click (no immediate flip-back or double flip).
On the public Portfolio page, clicking a video pauses it and flips to the back showing the description; clicking again flips back to the front; the state changes exactly once per click.
Clicking the “View Full” button on the flip-card back opens the lightbox and does not change the flip state.
Keyboard interaction (Enter/Space) flips exactly once and follows the same rules as mouse click.

requirements.text: Ensure video hover behavior on public Portfolio flip-cards matches the specified rules exactly and is resilient across browsers (autoplay policy differences must not break the UI).

quotes: public flip‑cards for photos and videos with your exact interaction rules, and the hover/click logic for videos vs photos implemented precisely.

acceptanceCriteria: When hovering a video flip-card front, the video attempts to autoplay; when unhovering, it pauses.
When a video card is flipped to the back, hover does not start playback until the card is flipped back to the front.
If the browser blocks autoplay, the UI remains functional (no crashes, no infinite error toasts); the video remains paused and can still be flipped via click.

requirements.text: Prevent memory leaks from repeated Portfolio browsing by cleaning up object URLs created for portfolio image/video previews in the public grid and lightbox.

quotes: Finish the update with the rest of these features! Build it!

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating into and out of the Portfolio page repeatedly does not continuously increase memory usage due to unreleased object URLs.
Object URLs created for grid thumbnails and the lightbox media are revoked when no longer needed (e.g., component unmount or item change).
No broken images/videos appear due to premature revocation (revocation only occurs after the media is no longer displayed).

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/immutablePaths (compose read-only components instead of editing them).
Keep the Internet Computer backend as a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend/main.mo); only add backend/migration.mo changes if state migration is required.
Use English for any user-facing text.
Do not log or expose any secrets (including admin verification codes) in browser console output, backend logs, error messages, or frontend bundles.
nonGoals: Adding new Portfolio product features beyond Phase 1 (e.g., comments, likes, tagging).
Changing the overall site theme, copy, or navigation beyond what is necessary to complete the Phase 1 Portfolio interaction behavior.
Refactoring unrelated admin/auth flows not required to complete the portfolio flip-card behavior.
